title: Split squat with wall support

steps.text: Stand side-on to a wall with one hand on it. Take a long step forward with the leg nearest the wall.
steps.cue: Side-on to the wall. One long step forward.

steps.text: Lift your back heel. Bend both knees and lower your body straight down.
steps.cue: Back heel up. Lower straight down.

steps.text: Stop when your front thigh is partway to level. Keep the front knee over the ankle and your body upright.
steps.cue: Front knee over the ankle. Body upright.

steps.text: Press through the front foot and come back up.
steps.cue: Press through the front foot. Come up.

steps.text: Finish your reps, then turn round and change legs.
steps.say: Finish your reps on this side.

mistakes: Letting the front knee fall inward.
Leaning the body forward over the front leg.
regression: Take a shorter step and lower only a little way.
stopIf: Stop if you feel pain in either knee, or feel unsteady.

anatomy.why: The front thigh and buttock lift you, while the side of the hip keeps you steady over a narrow base.
